description: The non-scanner figures SCANNER_EVIDENCE.json carries, held in a COMMITTED file rather than passed as command-line arguments. This is what makes the receipt's byte identity checkable: regeneration now depends only on committed inputs plus the raw Slither run plus git, so CI can rebuild the receipt and compare bytes. While these arrived as CLI flags, an operator could hand-edit any of them into the receipt and no check would notice -- the value was never derived from anything, so there was nothing to disagree with.
